annotations.title: Post a club ride or run

description: Post a DRAFT group ride (Windline) or club run (RunFast) on a club or organiser page the signed-in person runs, from a GPX route or link, once or weekly: always for the group, never private. Publish it with publish_event. Confirm the details with the user first. If the signed-in person runs any club or organiser page (list_my_events lists them) and hasn't said who it's for, ask one short question first: is this a private ride or run for you, or a group ride or run for <club name>? Then use post_club_ride for the club, or create_event with visibility private for themselves. A route can also come from another app's tool as its points or an encoded polyline (for example a route or activity map from a fitness app): pass it as polyline or points. Never ask the user to export a GPX if you already have the route's points.

description.description: What the ride or run is, for the club page.

gpx.description: The GPX file's text (up to 5 MB): if the user pasted it, or attached a file you can read yourself (for example with code).

gpx_file.description: The GPX or route file the user attached (ChatGPT passes it here).

file_name.description: Its name, if known (the route's name; never an event's).

name.description: The ride's or run's name, e.g. "Saturday coffee ride".

page.description: The club or organiser page address (livedot.me/<address>).

place.description: RunFast: where it starts, in words.

points.description: The route as its points: [[lat, lon], …], with elevation in metres as a third number if known. Up to 50,000. Use it for points another app's tool gave, or that you read from an attached file (GPX, FIT, TCX) with code.

polyline.description: The route as an encoded polyline (Google's format, precision 5 or 6), as another app's tool gives it (a route's or an activity's map).

start.description: A one-off: "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM" local. Weekly: the first one.

tz.description: IANA time zone; else worked out from where the route starts.

url.description: A link to the route: a Ride with GPS route, ride or collection (a collection gives one day per route), or any public link to a GPX file. Not Strava.

name: post_club_ride

outputSchema.description: The club ride, posted on the club's page.

app.description: The account's app: windline or runfast.

clubs.description: list_my_events on RunFast: the clubs they run ({ slug, name }).

days.description: The plan: each day with its file, from, to, km, climbing and start.

error.description: When the call failed: what went wrong, in words for the user.

events.description: list_my_events: each event with id, name, status (draft or published), dates, km, finished, and its dashboard and public links.

link.description: A private event: its private link (Windline) or where the app opens it (RunFast).

message.description: When view is "none": what to tell the user (no match, not live yet, a question back).

note.description: The plan: when the file numbers and the map disagree.

order.description: The plan (view tour_plan): how the days were ordered.

pages.description: list_my_events on Windline: the club and organiser pages they run ({ slug, name, type }). Ask who a new ride is for when there are any.

signup.description: Without a sign-in: { label, url } to make a free Windline or RunFast account (?ref=mcp).

sponsor_line.description: The line every answer ends with: who brings livedot's live tracking free.

view.description: What this answer is; "none" when there is nothing to show (see message).

visibility.description: private (just for them) or shared (for a group).

title: Post a club ride or run
